summary: Completed backend and frontend validation for scraper provider settings/auth flows and Product Sourcing method-chip rendering without live third-party calls.
action_items: Optional hardening: make _ensure_main_admin_seeded idempotent for password updates when an expected main-admin row already exists (currently returns early when any admin account exists).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/scraper/apis correctly redacts secrets: api_key/username/password raw values are not returned; only *_set and *_masked metadata are exposed.
PATCH /api/scraper/apis preserves built-in providers and supports add/remove custom HTTPS providers without contacting external provider endpoints.

Admin auth controls verified: login sets secure httpOnly admin_access_token cookie, brute-force lockout triggers at 5 failed attempts, and CORS preflight returns explicit allow-origin with allow-credentials=true.
seed_data_creation: No seeded business data created. Temporary custom provider test record was added then removed in PATCH flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: No live scraper-provider or eBay calls were executed. QA admin login worked. Scraper APIs tab and Product Sourcing method chips are aligned with explicit provider configuration and no legacy provider localStorage keys were detected.
rca of the issue: No blocking defect reproduced in requested scope. Prior UI selector failures were test-script path issues (hidden nav-settings button variant), resolved by using the visible Open Settings button flow.
